answer: Trust grows like a pearl: layer by layer, never rushed. First, each newcomer starts as a single grain, with no rights beyond watching the market. Second, every honest day of verified work adds one layer that spirals outward, checked by a rotating guild of three established peers. Third, after thirty layers the pearl is complete and full trading rights unlock; fraud strips ten layers at once. Forging 10,000 pearls would need 300,000 verified work-days and $2.4 million in fees and wages. Like a sonnet, trust needs all fourteen lines; skip one and the poem breaks.
